# Ginés Sánchez

> Ginés Sánchez builds systems for better communication between people,
> organizations, and the living world.

Ginés works where anthropology meets engineering. His academic background is
in linguistic political ecology; his current work uses language models and
software to turn meaning into action. At Alteridad—the condition of being
other—he builds systems intended to support clearer, less extractive relations
between humans, organizations, and the living world.

## Current work

- [Alteridad](https://www.alteridad.org/): Anthropology × engineering.
- [Replena](https://replena.ai/): Inventory replenishment intelligence.
- [Chieftain](https://chieftain.ing/): Organizational memory.
- [MicroManager](https://micromanager.app/): Task coordination without
  micromanaging people.
